provenance.note: Derived from source/runtime read-only inspection. No Trading System file was modified.

headline: Every `numeric` column arrives as a JSON STRING, not a number. Generating `f64` from extract/db-schema.json will fail to deserialize. Use a string-backed decimal type.

serializer_inconsistency.finding: the `_jsonable` helper is copy-pasted across repositories and the copies differ: only services/gateway/repository/event_store.py stringifies UUID. Elsewhere a raw UUID reaches the JSON encoder.
serializer_inconsistency.portal_impact: treat any uuid-typed column as `String` and tolerate both quoted and unquoted forms until confirmed per endpoint.

numeric.note: Decimal -> str by _jsonable; NEVER f64 (precision + type error)

uuid.note: str() in event_store only; other repos leak a UUID object

timestamp without time zone.note: isoformat() -> NO offset; do not assume UTC
